content.label: I have tried so many different transcription apps (including very expensive ones), and this is by far the best. It is so good and so precise at formatting voice memos for any type of content (whether lists, emails, idea outlines, long unstructured thoughts etc.) that I find myself using it just because it's so satisfying to see it do its magic. I wrote this review with Wispr Flow, and I haven't specified anything in terms of punctuation. I also stumbled upon words a few times, started again a bunch of times, and it's just so good giving a very clean transcription consistently. THANK YOU FOR MAKING THIS APP.
